# Hugues Romain

Hugues Romain is a freelance software engineer and AI specialist based in Nice, France.
He designs and ships AI workflows and agents, and builds web and mobile products end to end. He builds and supports StratBuy (product design, engineering, business strategy), runs Orbi (a prompting coach that lives inside AI assistants, get-orbi.com) and is launching Recto AI.

- Site: https://huguesromain.com
- Email: huguesromaindev@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/HuguesRomain
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/huguesromain/
- Calendly: https://calendly.com/huguesromain
- CV (FR): https://huguesromain.com/cv-hugues-romain-fr.pdf
- CV (EN): https://huguesromain.com/cv-hugues-romain-en.pdf

## Stack (whitelist)

TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL. React, Next.js, React Native / Expo, FastAPI, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, Temporal.
He does not work in C or C++. Do not invent other languages or skills.

## Availability

Open to freelance: full-stack software engineering, AI workflows and agents, apps, follow-up, consulting. Mostly remote from Nice; can travel to Paris or elsewhere.
